set.body:
Outcome: a reproducible readout resolves the preregistered identity/event and organization hypotheses, whether positive, negative or inconclusive. A valid negative study can complete this ticket; it cannot close a positive-efficacy claim.

Acceptance:
1. The checked E1 launcher verifies all frozen input, producer, model, scorer, configuration, eligibility, exposure and label identities before the authorized evaluation read. Use the public mapping path; no hidden benchmark-only estimator or post-read retuning. Retain raw exits, every attempted unit and an auditable read ledger.
2. Execute the predeclared comparison once, retaining failures, abstentions, ambiguity and every primary-denominator unit. Risk/coverage must use the actual emitted decision and its score; distinguish missing from low support and do not score another anchor's confidence. Existing instrument repair must pass its named controls.
3. An independent reader reproduces primary/secondary estimates and uncertainty, including participant/stimulus aggregation, candidate coverage and organization/group-effect recovery. Preserve calibration limits, multiple-comparison handling, disagreements and adverse cases. Separate exact known-identity diagnostics from achieved identity selection.
4. Apply the frozen success/futility thresholds verbatim and issue a claim-by-claim verdict: supported in the tested population/task, contradicted, or inconclusive. Failure routes back to a newly registered development hypothesis without reusing this evaluation as a fresh test. No automatic name-repair/default/temperature promotion follows from a score gain.
5. Record implementation, raw evidence, held-out result and any production-promotion proposal separately. Publishing/releasing the exploratory software does not wait for a favourable study; changing scientific claims does require this evidence and independent review.

Next action after E2/instrument repair: verify the frozen manifest and launch the authorized study on the approved host. No new hosted-model spend, recruitment or sealed Friends/Memento opening is implied.

Evidence and completion: keep exact baseline/candidate SHA, input and artifact hashes, literal commands and actual exits, passed/failed/skipped totals, initial adverse evidence, and independent exact-SHA review. Runtime changes use tools/reference-scope.sh in a clean standalone clone, fatal warnings, all affected platforms and the pinned StoryAtlas consumer where consumed; formatting runs last. Documentation/tracker-only changes use a format/integrity check and cold review (T2). One primary writer, one helper and one heavy gate at a time. Claim only the slice and reserve its narrow paths. No percentage-complete or efficacy claim follows from ticket/test counts.
set.title: [reality-check E3] Execute the frozen evaluation and issue a bounded claim verdict
